name: release-rebalance-shipyard-0.1.0
desc: New mod Rebalance Shipyard 0.1.0: shipyard Buy list keeps only Technical 0 ships (new saves), then commit and push.
commits: feat(rebalance-shipyard): shipyard Buy list sells only lowest-grade ships

New mod Restitutor_Rebalance_Shipyard 0.1.0 (Mods/Rebalance). One postfix on WorldPortBuildShipData.GetBuyShipList drops ships with Ship.technical > 0, so the natural refill of the Buy stock only offers cog / sloop / Chinese sloop regardless of city development. Player-ordered builds are untouched. Keeps the original list if filtering would empty it. New saves only; saves are not read or written. Requires Restitutor.Core 0.1.0+.
chore: release script for Rebalance Shipyard 0.1.0
oneshot.py gains an optional session parameter for the attribution line.
